title: Nanopore Assay for Fingerprinting DNA Binding and Quantifying Real-Time Cleavage by Catalytically Active Cas9 Enzyme
authors: Punitkumar Nagpure; Sarangi Suresh; Divya Shet; Gautam V. Soni
one_liner_zh: 该文用纳米孔传感技术指纹识别Cas9蛋白在DNA上的结合位置并实时定量切割动力学，属于蛋白质-DNA互作的单分子实验检测，但无AI或物理模拟建模方法，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Nanopore sensing, a high-resolution DNA sequencing technology, is fast expanding into novel and exciting direction of probing specific DNA-enzyme interactions. Although proven excellent for detection of structural features of bare DNA, quantitative measurements on enzyme-DNA complexes and its real-time activity are lagging and only starting to emerge for long DNA templates. Signal-to-noise requirement and high translocation speeds make it difficult to detect protein bound on biologically relevant plasmid length DNA. To this end we report accurate position detection of a catalytically active Cas9 bound to its single or multiple target sites on the DNA. Protein position is fingerprinted using event charge deficit (ECD) based analysis of the high signal-to-noise electrical signals as the complex translocates through a glass nanopore. Using a time dependent assay, we quantify kinetics of the released products upon enzymatic cleavage of the target DNA by the wild-type Cas9 nuclease. Our approach enables the nanopore based single molecule sensing of DNA-protein complexes, for real-time monitoring of biochemical reactions. This may help understand protein binding & localization as well as improve Cas9 based targeting in genome engineering applications. TOC Figure
abstract_zh: 纳米孔传感，一种高分辨率的DNA测序技术，正迅速扩展到探测特定DNA-酶相互作用的新颖且激动人心的方向。尽管在检测裸DNA结构特征方面表现出色，但对酶-DNA复合物及其实时活性的定量测量仍滞后，且仅开始针对长DNA模板出现。信噪比要求和高易位速度使得检测生物相关质粒长度DNA上结合的蛋白质变得困难。为此，我们报告了催化活性Cas9结合到其DNA上单个或多个靶位点的精确位置检测。蛋白质位置通过基于事件电荷亏缺（ECD）分析的高信噪比电信号进行指纹识别，该信号在复合物通过玻璃纳米孔易位时产生。利用时间依赖性测定，我们量化了野生型Cas9核酸酶对靶DNA酶切后释放产物的动力学。我们的方法实现了基于纳米孔的单分子传感DNA-蛋白质复合物，用于实时监测生化反应。这可能有助于理解蛋白质结合与定位，并改善基因组工程应用中基于Cas9的靶向。TOC图
